subject: Updating the R Shiny UI dynamically

messages.author: d8091f5c10a39a90
messages.subject: Updating the R Shiny UI dynamically
parts:
I was working on a basic data manipulation exercise in which I need to create dynamic UI.
For example - I have a SQL query which leads to creation of a dataset in R. 
Now, based on the schema of the dataset (eg. - no.of rows, column attributes) I want to generate a tab that contains list of check boxes that gets updated every iteration I run.Based on which I can decide I want to keep or delete the outputs.
Any ideas if this is possible ?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Updating the R Shiny UI dynamically
parts:
Yes, you'll want to use renderUI as described in this article:

messages.subject: Re: Updating the R Shiny UI dynamically
parts:
Thanks Joe ! 
But what I'm actually trying to achieve is a little more tricky - UI - I'm taking some inputs from the user eg. State and Segment Server - I'm using these inputs for subsetting a dataset that has State and Segment as fields What I have achieved so far -  Run the sql query to filter and export the output in a CSV. What I want to do is - Using renderUI and OutputUI, I want to generate a check box every time my SQL fires.   I tried to write the renderUI function as follows - output$cboxlist <- renderUI({ checkboxInput("cboxlist", label = h5("Your sql iterations"), value = FALSE) and added a uiOutput("cboxlist") in the UI as well I see a check box getting populated in the output, but I am unable to make it dynamic. I'm not sure how to generate an if condition such that I get a check box in the UI as a result of each iteration?
